text:
morgan: Quick UX spike — compact compare looks cramped when you add many filters + pin a version. Screenshot: https://img.example/compare-compact. Noticed pill wrap and badges get pushed down. tara: saw it. Main problem is toolbar vertical jitter when toggling pin. Users feel the page 'jumps'. diego: proposal: reserve an explicit slot on the right for pin + actions (fixed width) so pills never wrap. That keeps height stable. morgan: I like that. But where do perf badges live? They need to be visible but not overpowering. evan: move badges into the left of each row as compact icons, with full details in a popover on click/keyboard. Desktop shows icons, mobile goes to popover by default. sasha: microcopy: replace "Pin version" with "Lock to version" in the toolbar and add a tooltip: "Locks compare to this model version; metrics freeze unless Live is enabled." rui: accessibility: if we collapse badges to an icon, ensure the icon has aria-haspopup and aria-label like "Open performance details, 3 metrics". Also use role=status for live metric updates so SRs announce changes. tara: question — when locked should metrics snapshot or stay live? UX ops favor snapshot for reproducibility. We can surface a small toggle: "Live" to re-enable updates per-session. diego: agree snapshot default. Implementation detail: snapshot on pin with timestamp in tooltip: "Frozen at 2026-03-20 11:22 UTC". Also add a small dot indicator when live is enabled. evan: styling: de-emphasize badges — 12px label, light outline, icon-only by default. Only use color for warnings/regressions. sasha: accessibility copy: SR text when pin toggles: "Compare locked to v1.9.2. Live updates off." If policy allows fallbacks include that: "Policy: allow fallbacks". rui: keyboard flow: Tab >> pills >> +N overflow >> Pin button >> Row list. +N should be a button with aria-expanded and open a focus-trapped listbox. Example: `` then `
    `. morgan: analytics ask: track catalog.pin_mode_changed, catalog.badge_popover_open and catalog.overflow_opened. Goal: reduce CLS metric and measure pin engagement. diego: quick CSS sketch to reserve slot: `.compare-toolbar { min-height: 48px; display:flex; align-items:center; } .toolbar-actions { width: 160px; flex: 0 0 160px; } .pill-rail { flex: 1 1 auto; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; }` Keeps pills single-line. evan: mobile nuance: sticky right slot may hide under small screens. On <420px switch to stacked layout: pills above, actions below, but still avoid vertical jump by animating opacity only. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. sasha: copy tests: A) "Lock to version", B) "Pin version", C) "Freeze compare". Run small experiment to see which has clearer intent. rui: accessibility follow-up: add aria-live polite for the toast after pin with Undo button. Example: `
    Compare locked to v1.9.2.
    ` morgan: consensus items: 1) reserve right-side action slot (design+eng). 2) collapse badges to icons + popover (design). 3) default pin behavior: snapshot with optional Live toggle (product). 4) accessibility updates per rui above (a11y). 5) instrument events (pm). 6) copy A/B test (growth). tara: I'll own the spec doc and add keyboard diagrams. diego: I'll open a small PR for the CSS slot + pill ellipsis. Estimate: 2 days. evan: I'll draft the badge popover interactions and mobile rule. sasha: I'll write copy variants and tooltips. rui: will add aria examples and test flows with VO/NVDA. design-bot: uploaded frame "compact-compare/right-action-slot-and-badge-popover" to Figma with states. morgan: thanks all. Follow-up: ensure +N count excludes pinned chips and the hidden filter list preserves original order. Also make the pin slot width responsive but stable so pills don't shift.
